## Before you send it

- [ ] It belongs to an issue that was answered first, or it is a small fix.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, the DCO).
- [ ] No real person's name, address, mail, key or other private data is in it.
- [ ] I said above if a large part of it was written with an AI tool.
- [ ] It is not a security fix. (A security fix is reported privately first: SECURITY.md.)
